concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-metronome-api-reference-notifications-edit-an-offset-lifecycle-event-notification-configuration]] - offset lifecycle event notification configuration editing, the fixed existing lifecycle-event type, signed offset routing, and the system-only enablement boundary
warnings: This operation edits stored notification configuration; it does not establish threshold-alert evaluation, lifecycle-event occurrence, notification emission, or webhook delivery.

The shared edit schema also supports system lifecycle event configuration updates; is_enabled is documented only for system lifecycle events and must not be presented as an offset-configuration toggle.
